summary: Tested Company Drive directory (backend + UI), AGTS favourites rename/kinds/admin-only, and the leaderboard/pathway small fixes. Backend: 12/12 pytest pass. Frontend: /places crashed on every load with a render error (ReferenceError: Cannot access 'params' before initialization, places.tsx line 24 used `params` before its declaration on line 28). This blocked the AGTS favourites screen and the 'AGTS Favourite' target in directory-new. The testing agent fixed it by reordering the declarations. After the fix, all requested UI flows passed for admin and employee. No deprecated Expo packages detected.

minor.issue: An invalid space/category returns 200 [] instead of 400. Only POST/PUT validate these values.
Stored objects are never removed from object storage, so files are orphaned.
get_object is not wrapped in try/except, so a storage failure returns an unhandled 500 (upload returns a friendly 502).

ui_bugs.issue: Render crash on every load: `params` (useLocalSearchParams) was used in useState on line 24 before `const params` on line 28 (TDZ ReferenceError). The error boundary showed 'Something went wrong'. FIXED by the testing agent (moved params/useAuth above the useState calls).

issues: The category button 'Trusted Referral Partner Organisations' is truncated to 'Trusted Referral Partner …' at 375px (numberOfLines=2, 12px). Consider a shorter label, 3 lines, or a wrapped/stacked layout.
Admin trash icon deletes a favourite immediately with no confirm sheet. /directory uses ConfirmSheet, so this is inconsistent and accidental deletes are easy.
The 'Admins only' empty state has no back/close action when opened directly (no header back on web).

action_items: Review the testing agent's fix in /app/frontend/app/places.tsx (hook/variable ordering). It is required to open AGTS favourites.
Optional: return 400 for an invalid space/category on GET /api/directory.
Optional: delete storage objects when deleting directory files/entries, and handle get_object errors (502/404) in the file download.
Optional: add a ConfirmSheet to place deletion, and fix the truncated 'Trusted Referral Partner Organisations' label on /drive.
critical_code_review_comments: places.tsx used a const before its declaration inside the component (fixed). Lint with no-use-before-define to catch this.
directory.add_file reads the whole upload into memory before the 15 MB check. Acceptable but could stream.
PlaceChips (event location) still lists all kinds (Coffee, WiFi / Meet). This may be intentional; only the lunch picker is restricted to Eat & Drink (verified).

success_rate.frontend: 100% after the places.tsx fix (0% for /places before the fix)

seed_data_creation: TEST_ directory entries and places were created during tests and all deleted afterwards (directory and places collections are now empty).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Leaderboard is admin/support_office only (an employee gets 403 before the period check). In this env Google Drive shows 'Therapist Resources isn't set up yet' / an empty folder, and the category + favourites buttons render above it. The directory file picker works on web via page.expect_file_chooser on directory-attach-button. Directory file open launches a new tab with ?token=. The places DB was empty before testing (no legacy kinds to migrate).
rca_of_issue: places.tsx: `const params = useLocalSearchParams()` was declared after `useState(params.kind ...)`. In the Hermes/web bundle, const keeps TDZ semantics, so the first render threw a ReferenceError. Reproduce: open /places as any user. Mitigation: declare params and useAuth before the dependent useState calls (applied).
